def transform(grid):
    """The solid multicolor vertical bar-stack (legend) is erased; only legend colors directly
    adjacent (in the legend) to a present shape's color become a copy of that nearest shape,
    recolored, placed contiguously above (colors before it) or below (colors after it)."""
    bars = {}; shapes = []
    for c, cells in all_components(grid):
        rs = [a for a, b in cells]; cs = [b for a, b in cells]
        r0, r1, c0, c1 = min(rs), max(rs), min(cs), max(cs)
        if c0 == c1 and len(cells) == r1 - r0 + 1:
            bars.setdefault((r0, r1), {})[c0] = c
        else:
            shapes.append((c, (r0, r1, c0, c1), cells))
    span = max(bars, key=lambda s: len(bars[s]))
    cols = sorted(bars[span]); L = [bars[span][j] for j in cols]
    smap = {c: (box, cells) for c, box, cells in shapes}
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for a in range(span[0], span[1] + 1):
        for b in cols: out[a][b] = 0
    present = [i for i, c in enumerate(L) if c in smap]
    todo = set(present)
    for p in present:
        for q in (p - 1, p + 1):
            if 0 <= q < len(L): todo.add(q)
    rtop = smap[L[present[0]]][0][0]
    for i in sorted(todo):
        if i < present[0]:
            sbox, scells = smap[L[min(present, key=lambda p: abs(p - i))]]
            hh = sbox[1] - sbox[0] + 1; rtop -= hh
            for a, b in scells: out[rtop + a - sbox[0]][b] = L[i]
    rbot = smap[L[present[-1]]][0][1]
    for i in sorted(todo):
        if i > present[-1]:

            hh = sbox[1] - sbox[0] + 1; rbot += 1
            for a, b in scells: out[rbot + a - sbox[0]][b] = L[i]
            rbot += hh - 1
    return out
''')
